text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-M-08, Sleek Stainless Steel Foucault Pull

Simply changing the hardware on cabinets, on dressers, or on accordion closet doors can transform a space into into something that feels totally new. The Sleek Stainless Steel Foucault Cabinet Pull has a beautiful shape that will look great in traditional and modern decors. It has a brushed stainless steel finish.

Also Available Matching Foucault Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Sleek Stainless Steel Foucault Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 4-7/16"
  • Height: 9/16"
  • Projection: 3/4"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
